content.text: {"id": "mm6337a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Nationally, 81.8% of HCP included in National Healthcare Safety Network data were reported as receiving influenza vaccination"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "analyzed to calculate proportions of HCP reported as vaccinated"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion vaccinated was expressed as a percentage calculated as the number of HCP vaccinated"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "Proportion of health care personnel (HCP) reported vaccinated for influenza by reporting acute care hospitals"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall in the United States, 81.8% of hospital-based HCP included in NHSN data reported receiving influenza vaccination"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Similar patterns were noted at the state level"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Just over one quarter of states reached the Healthy People 2020 (HP2020) target of 90% influenza vaccination among HCP"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "NHSN is a secure, voluntary, web-based surveillance system managed by CDC"}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) is the data source for measuring progress toward the HP2020 target"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "calculated as the number of HCP vaccinated at their facility plus the number who provided documentation of vaccination elsewhere"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The measure denominator included HCP with unknown vaccination status"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data were aggregated for all hospitals within a state and analyzed to calculate proportions"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "When restricted to those with known vaccination status"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
